title: Project root discovery ordering, live agent refresh, tactile read_file line range badge, and prominent agent response header
commitMessage: feat(ui/cortex): active_project precedence, cortex personas reload, tactile read_file badge, prominent agent response
author: agent-developer (Lead Subagent Level 1)

sensors.frontend_build_npm: pass (pnpm run build: tsc && vite build 0 errors)

summary: Fixed multi-tier project discovery ordering in Rust backend to prioritize %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.voimax.cvh\active_project.txt over current_dir fallback, preventing CanbanVoimaxHarness from overriding the user's active workspace. Updated projectStore.ts and App.tsx to automatically invoke set_active_project on startup and trigger synchronous reloads of boards, tasks, agent personas, and column stages upon project switch. Added a live agent persona refresh button with RotateCw spin animation in CortexExplorer Section 2. Implemented tactile presentation for file read operations (read_file, read, fetch_file) in ToolExecutionCard with an 'Analyzed' cyan badge, language-specific badges (.cs -> C#, .ts -> TS, .py -> PY, etc.), dynamic line range indicators (#L{start}-{end}), and formatted line numbers upon expansion. Restyled the 'Ответ агента' drawer block header in AgentConsoleDrawer to be larger (text-sm font-semibold), more spacious (px-4 py-3), and visually prominent with a tactile border and shadow.
